value.rationale: A central ecological problem is whether similar abundance time series can reveal hard three-body mechanisms. The theorem supplies a precise mathematical divide: generically exact one-trajectory noiseless structural recovery needs no controlled intervention, yet an explicit positive globally bounded nonstationary leaf is truly blind. The model-specific finite observation budget and algebraic exceptional condition address experimental identifiability directly, while avoiding unsupported claims of stable numerical inference.
